Body.Content:
An update to Azure Automation Hybrid Worker has just been released. You can verify that the latest version has been applied to your Microsoft Monitoring Agent installation by confirming that the following subfolder matches this version number: %ProgramFiles%\Microsoft Monitoring Agent\Agent\AzureAutomation\7.2.7396.0.  This version includes the following improvements:
  • Reliability fixes
  • Ability to work with the “Windows PowerShell\Turn on Script Execution” policy enabled
  • Pre-check for proxy setting during worker registration, with a clear error message when it fails the check
  • Support for running graphical runbooks, consistent with running them directly in Azure
For the update to be successfully installed, you need to restart the Microsoft Monitoring Agent service.
Body.Markdown:
An update to Azure Automation Hybrid Worker has just been released. You can verify that the latest version has been applied to your Microsoft Monitoring Agent installation by confirming that the following subfolder matches this version number: %ProgramFiles%\Microsoft Monitoring Agent\Agent\AzureAutomation\7.2.7396.0. This version includes the following improvements:

Reliability fixes

Ability to work with the “Windows PowerShell\Turn on Script Execution” policy enabled

Pre-check for proxy setting during worker registration, with a clear error message when it fails the check

Support for running graphical runbooks, consistent with running them directly in Azure

For the update to be successfully installed, you need to restart the Microsoft Monitoring Agent service.
